name: zeffect_anim_queue_cmd_type4_transform_refs
description: zEffectAnim::QueueCmdType4TransformRefs conditionally queues or dispatches a transform-reference activation record with validated node tokens and two reference vectors.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional through queue, dispatch, and record-field smoke tests.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x461d00 validates bound/ref node token validation, global queue/dispatch gates, per-entry override bits, type 4 record allocation, name copy, node-token storage, ref-node token storage, zero-vector fallback for null refs, optional callback dispatch, discard when dispatch-only, and dispatched-record return.
The native activation-record smoke verifies queued type 4 record fields and packed size through the shared zEffect activation-record queue path.
